Name: Json Assets - Ghostytea's Cute Hats (Unofficial Conversion)
Author: bikinavisho
Description:
This is a conversion of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1754]GhostyTea's Cute Hats[/url] mod to a Json Assets content pack, meaning you will be able to purchase all of the cute hats and still keep all your vanilla hats also :) 


[u]To Install: 
[/u][list]
[*]Install SMAPI and Json Assets
[*]Install this mod, drag it into your Mods folder
[/list]
All hats can be purchased at the Mouse's Hat shop in the woods, for 1,000G.


Note: I have reached out to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/40505835]GhostyTea [/url]﻿for their blessing with this conversion and as of writing this have yet to receive a response. I will update this when I hear back from them.
